notes.text: keep it simple for v1, focus on the core components; should look clean and professional

system.name: Instructor
system.summary: Instructor is an adaptive learning-course agent. A Next.js app proxies every /api call to a FastAPI backend, which runs product skills through an in-process agent package. The agent package is the only caller of the Anthropic API. Postgres is the source of truth; Redis holds sessions and caches that can always be rebuilt.
highlights: Postgres is the only source of truth; Redis holds nothing that can't be rebuilt.
Every LLM call goes through one wrapper: Pydantic-validated output, one retry, every attempt logged to llm_calls.
The browser only talks to Next.js, which proxies /api/* to FastAPI, so the session cookie stays same-origin.
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY lives in .env and is read by the API process only; the browser never sees it.
Both data stores bind to 127.0.0.1, so they are not exposed on the network.

components.name: Learner
components.responsibility: Takes a course through the browser: intake, diagnostic, lessons and quizzes.

components.name: Web app
components.responsibility: Renders the UI, redirects visitors without a session cookie, and proxies /api/* to FastAPI.

components.name: API
components.responsibility: Authenticates the user, enforces ownership, runs services and routes skill calls to the agent.

components.name: Agent package
components.responsibility: Loads product skills and prompts, and makes every model call through one validated, logged client.

components.name: Postgres
components.responsibility: Source of truth for users, courses, enrollments, assessments, progress and the LLM call log.

holds.data: Orgs, users, courses, enrollments, assessments, plans, progress
llm_calls: one row per model request

components.name: Redis
components.responsibility: Holds login sessions and the dashboard cache; LLM response caches are planned for CP2/CP3.

components.name: Anthropic API
components.responsibility: Generates structured diagnostic, lesson and grading output for the skills.

flows.name: Generate diagnostic questions
flows.description: After a learner creates a course, the API asks the diagnose skill for probe questions and stores them.

steps.msg: Load the course; check the user owns it
